data: What is the data used for training, and how does it influence the accuracy results for each language pair?

The data used for training is the number of parallel sentences. The accuracy results for each language pair increase as the number of parallel sentences increases. The SDAE (transfer) model achieves the highest accuracy, followed by SDAE (sent), SDAE/NMT (joint), FastText (sent), and FastText (dict).
